//: Every TypeScript file this package owns except those the build compiles: type-aware linting, and the `typecheck:test` gate. `tsconfig.json` excludes `*.test.ts` so they stay out of `dist/`, which would otherwise leave the test suites outside every TypeScript project — typescript-eslint's project service could not parse them and lint would fail with a parsing error instead of reporting anything. This project exists so the linter has a program covering them, and so nothing in a test file can rot unchecked.
